We supply dome cameras to more than 5,000 Go-Ahead buses on both new installs and vehicle refurbishments. Cameras are available as both dome or miniature cab shapes. Dome cameras are used more for larger vehicles due to their 360 coverage and flush mounted design. The cab cameras used in smaller vehicles offer HD recording for use with smaller channeled digital video recorders such as the MDVR range. If you have a fleet of vehicles we will also offer installation through one of our UK based engineers. Your fleet can then be managed using software such as SURE Enterprise which is able to track your fleet through GPS and capture live footage from the vehicle. "In April, Nottinghamshire based SURE Transport delivered an all in one CCTV kit. Having worked with many Tier 1 and 2 operators over the past few years, SURE Transport now offers a kit which is available to the public and relieves all of the stress involved in purchasing CCTV equipment.
